claim_scope: application completion isolation from independent QUIC streams on one live connection; not a claim about a custom QUIC frame, connection migration, or 0-RTT
comparison: same ordered object set and one connection per mode; a miss-heavy large object is first; multiplexed mode runs all streams concurrently while sequential mode completes each stream before opening the next
keying: one live TLS exporter output per connection, then per-stream ReduLink derivation using the actual QUIC stream ID
